name: Next Call: Lift & Diet Coach
subtitle: Weekly Workout & Calorie Plan
promotionalText: Log training, food and weight. Once a week you get one call: keep the plan or change it. Every call shows its reason, and says so when the data isn't enough.
description:
Next Call is a weekly coach for people who lift and track what they eat, and want one clear decision each week instead of a pile of charts.

Everything else shows you the data. This one makes the call.

Log your workouts, meals and weigh-ins. Once a week, Next Call looks at what you logged and makes one decision: keep the plan, or change your calories, steps or training loads. Every call shows what it looked at, the rule it followed, how sure it is, and when it will look again. When there isn't enough data yet, it says so instead of guessing.

HOW PEOPLE USE IT
• You lift three or four days a week and wonder when to add weight. Log sets with reps in reserve, and the next session's targets follow from your last one.
• You are cutting, and the scale jumps around. Weigh in, and the app reads the trend over weeks, not the swing from one morning to the next.
• You missed a week and don't know where to restart. Log what you can. There is no streak to lose and no guilt for a missed day.
• You train in two gyms with different equipment. Save each gym, so every target is a weight you can actually load.
• You are switching from another app. Bring in your past workouts from its export file.

TRAINING
• Sets, reps and reps in reserve, logged in seconds, offline too.
• Reps climb within a range, then the weight goes up a step.
• A lighter week when the numbers say you need one.
• Swap a move, or build your own program.

FOOD
• Search foods, scan a barcode, or save your own recipes.
• Estimates come as ranges, never one made-up number.

PROGRESS
• Body weight as a trend over weeks.
• Strength over time, move by move.
• Progress photos stay on your phone. The app never uploads them.

QUESTIONS
Who makes the call? Fixed rules do. Each rule is drawn from coaching practice or published sports science, and each call names the rule it used.
What if I disagree? A call changes when your data changes, not when you push back. You choose whether to apply it, and you can undo most calls.
Is it medical advice? No. It is a general wellness coach for adults. Check with your doctor before you change how you train or eat, and stop if something hurts.
Where does my data go? Apple Health data is read only if you allow it. You can export everything we hold about you, or delete your account and all of it, in Settings.

SUBSCRIPTION
Next Call needs a subscription, monthly or yearly. The price in your currency, and the 2-week free trial for new subscribers, are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time: open Settings on your iPhone, tap your name, then Subscriptions.
